prompt: Sprite sheet for a top-down action RPG hero in the style of classic 16-bit overhead adventure games, seen from a high three-quarter overhead angle. One character: a young ranger with a bright green hooded cloak, tan tunic, brown boots and a short sword on the back. A strict grid of 4 rows and 4 columns, 16 frames, evenly spaced, frames not touching each other, every frame the same size and the same character. Row 1: walk cycle facing the viewer (walking down). Row 2: walk cycle facing left. Row 3: walk cycle facing right. Row 4: walk cycle facing away (walking up). Each row is a 4-frame walk: contact, passing, contact with the other leg, passing. Clean readable pixel art, dark outline, bright colours. Background is one flat solid pure magenta colour (#FF00FF), no ground, no shadows, no text, no labels, no grid lines.
